g.text: What is built, on the unfolded faces (γ = 90°; size exaggerated to 0.4 of the edge length). Shaded strips: each band's footprint

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: (blue band 1, orange band 2). Dashed violet: the mitre C→q, which runs over the bands, not on the faces. Green: the overrun,

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: band k's cut-off by Fⱼ from q to its far foot p_k; the green region is what Fⱼ loses beyond band j's strip. Where p₁ = p₂ the mitre lands on L.
